props.title: Nested Repeat via $item Expression
props.description: Two-level repeat: outer iterates over categories, inner iterates over each category's items using { "$item": "items" } in the repeat path.
props.technicalDescription:
Spec
Outer repeat: path "/categories"
  ├─ CategoryTitle — reads name from scope
  └─ Inner repeat: path { "$item": "items" }
      ├─ BoundField for "name"
      └─ BoundField for "qty"

Store
{ categories: [{ name, items: [{ name, qty }] }] }

Features
• $item expression in repeat.path — resolved against the current PathContext
• Nested RepeatScope — each level sets a fully-qualified base path
• BoundField as repeat children — reads/writes the correct item path
• CategoryTitle as repeat child — reads category name from scope
